<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: x-large;"><i style="color: #333333;">Deck the Tree With False Blossoms</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
It is said that Emperor Yang (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">隋炀帝</span></span>,
569-618 A.D.) of Sui would try to dazzle traveling merchants by
offering grand concerts and free feasts. He would even decorate the
winter trees with flowers of silk to make it appear as though spring
had arrived.</span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Deck
the Tree With False Blossoms</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the 53rd hexagram, </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><i>Wood
over Mountain</i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">. On
the still and silent Mountain a tree grows slowly, weak though firmly
rooted, symbolizing movement that proceeds gradually, allowing for
transcendence over ordinary affairs </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">[1],
[28]</span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">.</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><br>

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">

LIST 29:</b></span></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section81" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">没有必要为了拍照买新的衬衫。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: There’s no need to
	buy a new shirt for a photo shoot.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不太喜欢那个节目的主持人，他经常很</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;紧张。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I don’t like the
	host of that show very much, he is always very nervous.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不想看这部电视剧，我想看动画片！</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">先下载程序，</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="zh-CN">
	</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">然后运行。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你还在修改那篇论文吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">没有，</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="zh-CN">
	</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">我已经向杂志提交过了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="background: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="background: rgb(255, 255, 255);">6) </span></span></span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">到了春天，它就会开花了。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="background: rgb(255, 255, 255);">&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="background: rgb(255, 255, 255);">7)</span></span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">这朵花送给你。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">8</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)
	I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">假期为什么</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="zh-CN">
	</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">都不能放松？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">II.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">因为我的小孩要参加的活动太多</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;了。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">III.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">例如呢？</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br><br>
	9) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">赶紧走，别迟到了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10)   <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我刚刚发现，我把钱包忘在车里了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11)   I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">以防万一我回来的时候你不在家，</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;你应该告诉我额外的钥匙在哪。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">II.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我家大门旁边有一个石头，石头下</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;面有一个盒子，钥匙在盒子里面。</span></span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12)   <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你举的例子有很多有意义的单词。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13)   <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我现在不想跟你说话，走开！</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的公司和他们的公司有合作。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	15) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你的卫衣怎么这么脏？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">刚刚吃了牛肉锅贴，弄脏了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">1</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">6</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">)</span></span>
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">你的工作材料登记了吗？</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p>
